## Plugin reference

- Description: BYPASS_TOKENS: every bypass file a guard may honour (.allow-main, …), declared as data, and the BypassToken type a guard's bypassToken must be — so a guard cannot name an undeclared file (tsc) and guards:bypass-tokens-declared fails on a declared one no guard honours. A leaf, so the conversation view's bypass chip reads the set without loading the guard registry.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by: `conversations/conversation-view/allow-monitor`
- Core:
  - Exports (types): `BypassToken`
  - Exports (values):
    - `BYPASS_TOKENS`
    - `isBypassToken`
